newsitem.title: USA: ILEX, LeukoSite in leukemia alliance.
newsitem.headline: ILEX, LeukoSite in leukemia alliance.

text.p: ILEX Oncology Inc said Monday that it and privately-held LeukoSite Inc have formed a joint venture to develop Campath-1H, a monoclonal antibody under development for the treatment of patients with chronic lymphocytic leukemia, the most prevalent form of adult leukemia in Western countries.
Chronic lymphocytic leukemia is a malignant disorder characterized by an accumulation of abnormal lymphocytes (white blood cells) in the body.
Over time, these lymphocytes spread to the tissues causing lymph node, liver and spleen enlargement and bone marrow dysfunction.
ILEX and LeukoSite will jointly own and manage the new venture, contribute equal amounts to capitalization and share equally in the compound's commercial future.
The joint venture plans to file applications with U.S. and European regulatory agencies in 1998 to begin a multi-center pivotal clinical trial.
